upgradePolicy.description: Specifies the upgrade policy for the service during milestone upgrade periods.

values.name: Automatic
values.description: The service will be automatically upgraded during the major upgrade window.

values.name: Deferred
values.description: Major upgrades are deferred by 30 days.

readyForUpgrade.description: Indicates the readiness status of the instance for upgrade.

values.name: NotApplicable
values.description: Upgrade readiness is not applicable because the upgradePolicy is set to Automatic.

values.name: Ready
values.description: The service has been marked as ready for upgrade. Only valid when upgradePolicy is Deferred.

values.name: NotReady
values.description: The service is not ready for upgrade. Default state when upgradePolicy is Deferred.

autoUpgradeAfterDate.description: The date after which the instance will be automatically upgraded if it doesn't get marked as ready for upgrade.
